faqs.question: What age is best to start Noorani Qaida?
faqs.answer: Children can start from age 5 or when they can focus for a 30-minute lesson. Our teachers adapt the pace to each child's ability.

faqs.question: How long does it take to complete Noorani Qaida?
faqs.answer: Most students complete the foundation in 3–6 months with regular classes, depending on age, practice time, and lesson frequency.

faqs.question: Are classes one-to-one for children?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every child learns with a dedicated teacher in a private online class for maximum attention and progress.

faqs.question: Can parents observe the classes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Parents are welcome to sit with younger children during lessons and receive regular progress updates from the teacher.

faqs.question: Do I need to know Tajweed before starting Hifz?
faqs.answer: Basic Quran reading ability is required. If needed, your teacher will strengthen Tajweed alongside memorization.

faqs.question: How many days per week are Hifz classes?
faqs.answer: Premium plans include up to 5 days per week. Your schedule is set based on your package and availability.

faqs.question: How long does full Quran Hifz take?
faqs.answer: Duration varies by student dedication and class frequency — typically 2–4 years with consistent practice and revision.

faqs.question: Is murajaah (revision) included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Revision is a core part of our Hifz program and is built into every lesson plan.

testimonials.name: Rahima Khatun
testimonials.content: Alhamdulillah, BD Online Quran Academy has been a blessing for our family. My daughter learns Noorani Qaida one-to-one with a caring female teacher. The class times fit our schedule perfectly.

testimonials.name: Ahmed Malik
testimonials.content: I enrolled in the Tajweed course while working full-time in the US. BDOQ Academy matched me with an experienced teacher who explains rules clearly in English. The live classes are interactive.

testimonials.name: Fatima Begum
testimonials.content: We chose BDOQ Academy because of their separate system for women and qualified Hafiz teachers. My son is memorizing the Quran with excellent supervision and monthly progress reports.

testimonials.name: Arafat Hossain
testimonials.content: Fortunately, due to knowing English and having a flexible schedule, I could continue learning Quran under Hafiz teachers. The qualified teachers of BDOQ Academy teach Tajweed excellently from Los Angeles.

testimonials.name: Abdullah
testimonials.content: I could never have imagined Quran from Bangladesh could be taught to such an international standard. I am confidently memorizing the Quran with a dedicated Hafiz teacher at BDOQ Academy.

testimonials.name: Nusrat Fatima
testimonials.content: In our country there are many madrasas, but not everyone has equal opportunities for women to learn. I found a place where women study with qualified female teachers only — that is why I chose BDOQ.

faq.question: How do I book a free trial class?
faq.answer: Visit our Free Trial Class page, fill in your name, contact details, subject interest, and preferred time. Our team will contact you via WhatsApp or email to confirm your schedule and assign a suitable teacher for your first session.

faq.question: When is BDOQ's class time?
faq.answer: BDOQ Academy offers flexible class times to suit students in Bangladesh and worldwide. You can choose morning, afternoon, or evening slots based on your timezone. Classes are scheduled according to your availability during registration.

faq.question: What platform do you use for online classes?
faq.answer: We conduct live classes through reliable video conferencing platforms with screen sharing and audio clarity optimized for Quran teaching. Your teacher will share the meeting link before each session, and technical support is available if needed.

faq.question: What age group can students enroll in the course?
faq.answer: Students of all ages can enroll — from young children starting Noorani Qaida to adults learning Tajweed or Hifz. We match each student with an appropriate teacher and learning plan based on age, level, and goals.

faq.question: How are teachers selected for students?
faq.answer: BDOQ Academy assigns teachers based on the student's gender, course type, language preference, and schedule. All teachers are experienced Hafiz or qualified scholars who undergo evaluation to maintain our international teaching standards.

faq.question: Is there a system for girls to learn the Holy Quran?
faq.answer: Yes. BDOQ Academy provides a fully separate education system for women and girls with qualified female teachers. This ensures privacy, comfort, and focused learning for sisters of all ages in a safe online environment.
